name: Dublin Youth Advisory Committee (YAC)
org: City of Dublin, Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Dublin teens give the City input. The input is on its programs and activities for young people. The committee meets monthly. It usually meets on the second Wednesday at the Dublin Senior Center.
grades: Enrolled in middle school or high school
who_can_apply: Must live in the City of Dublin and be enrolled in middle or high school (committee bylaws). The committee has 13 members and 3 alternates; at least 6 members must be high school students.
pay_detail: Volunteer committee seat. No pay is stated on the city page.
duration: One-year term. The 2026-27 members are listed for June 2026 to May 2027.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 seats are filled (term June 2026 to May 2027). The city page we read does not post a recruitment date for the 2027-28 term.
how_to_apply: Not stated on the city page we read. Call Parks and Community Services at 925-556-4500 or use the contact link on the committee page to ask when the next recruitment opens.
notes: Meets 7:00 pm, second Wednesday of the month, Dublin Senior Center, 7600 Amador Valley Blvd; July and August meet only as needed. Bylaws say members must stay enrolled in middle or high school, and a member is removed if they stop living in Dublin or stop being enrolled. Older (2020 and 2021) notices mention late-winter recruitment; that is last-cycle information and was not confirmed for 2027. Teens who want a seat should check the city page each spring.
